book.title: ME LOMA ꞌIDI LETA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Paulo ꞌina ona oboboma
Yada emataluwemi nuudai Pibe manuna, tauna ꞌasa Kenikilia ꞌidi ekalesiya ꞌenaya ꞌilemelemedi,

ta tuta nina ꞌabo ꞌiwawai ꞌemiya, nuwanuwagu be ꞌimi anuwaya wada bwauye, ꞌInapwana ꞌana esanega, manuna ꞌedaꞌeda gete nadigega Yaubada ꞌina tomotaiyao ꞌilobwenedi, be Pibe nina wada leme ꞌabo ꞌaina yage ꞌediyega ꞌikukupa, manuna tauna wate nadigega toekalesiyao yaudi ꞌiobobomedi, ta wate ꞌaboꞌagu nadigega ꞌilemegu.
Ta wate ꞌigu oboboma Pilisila be Akuila ꞌediya wada simane, taudi lowa maꞌegwao Yesu Keliso manuna ꞌaetoguinuwa,
ta wate yawasidi sitagwalena manugu tuta ꞌebe esilae ꞌediya. ꞌEnega manudi yalokagutoki sinabwana, ta nigeya ꞌaene taugumo ꞌigu lokagutoki, ta wate toekalesiyao sena apwesao ꞌediyega.

Ta wate ꞌigu oboboma wada simane taudi toekalesiyao nidi sidelideli egogona Akuila nina ꞌina anuwaya ꞌediya. Ta ꞌigu oboboma wate wasimane gosiyagu Epinito ꞌenaya, tauna Yesu Keliso ꞌana togimi emisa Esia ꞌina ꞌebe loinao ꞌenega.
Ta wate ꞌigu oboboma Meli ꞌenaya, tauna ꞌietapewa sinabwana manumi.

ꞌIgu oboboma wate gosegwao Anidaloniko be Dunia ꞌediya, taudi me Yudia lowa maꞌegwao deliya ꞌamiyami, siteluwa nidi ma ꞌadi ꞌamayaba Yesu ꞌana tosimanao ꞌediyega, manuna taudi togimi ekalesiya, ta muliyega ꞌaboꞌagu.
Ta wate ꞌigu oboboma gosiya ꞌaiꞌailigu Amipilia ꞌenaya, tauna ꞌida ꞌInapwana ꞌana toemisa ꞌebweu.
Ta wate ꞌigu oboboma Ulibano ꞌenaya, tauna maꞌeda Keliso manuna tapaipaisewa. Ta wate ꞌigu oboboma gosiyagu Sitakisi ꞌenaya.
Ta wate ꞌigu oboboma Apeli ꞌenaya, tauna Keliso ꞌana toemisa ꞌaiꞌaila. Ta Alisitobulo ma ina buꞌunao ꞌigu oboboma wate ꞌediya,
be wate Elodiani tauna goma Yudia, ta wate ꞌInapwana ꞌina bodao taudi Nakiso ꞌina anuwaya simiyami.
ꞌIgu oboboma wate Yesu ꞌina toguinuwao taudi Talipina be Taliposa ꞌediya. Ta wate gosiyagu Pelisi ꞌenaya, tauna ꞌida ꞌInapwana manuna ꞌietapewa sinabwana.
Ta wate Lupuso ꞌenaya, tauna toguinuwa boboꞌana ꞌInapwana manuna, be sinana wate ꞌenaya, tauna ꞌiobobomegu ꞌatuwa ꞌaboꞌagu natuꞌaiꞌailina.
ꞌIgu oboboma wate Asinikilito be Pilegoni be Elimi be Pataloba be Elimasi, be toekalesiyao nidi maꞌediyao wate ꞌediya.
ꞌIgu oboboma wate Pilologo be Dulia ꞌediya, ta wate tai nina Neliusa ma nuuna ꞌediya, be Olimipasi, be Yaubada ꞌina tomotaiyao boda nidi maꞌediyao ꞌediya.
ꞌEnega ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna gosemiyao egosigosiyana ꞌaiꞌailega wada enimalotuna. Ta wate toekalesiyao maiboꞌadi sena yauyauna ꞌediyega, ꞌidi oboboma ꞌomi toekalesiyao Loma ꞌenaya ꞌemiya.
Paulo ꞌina emataluwa ꞌana ꞌebe losalowa

Tasigwao, gete ꞌigu sida waiwai ꞌemiya be ꞌaene wada ꞌitaꞌitaꞌiꞌisimi taudi toweyalao ꞌediyega, manuna eꞌita nina lowa waꞌewenaya taudi geya nuwadi, ꞌenega siꞌawaꞌawa toꞌumaliyena, ta wate tomota ꞌidi emisa sigiegie nenetadi.

ꞌAbo yaisigedi taudi ꞌidi guinuwa gete nadigega, taudi nigeya ꞌida ꞌInapwana Keliso manuna sida guinuwa, ta esi taudimo ꞌidi nuwanuwao tuga siguiguinuwedi, manuna ꞌidi ona dibidibi ꞌediyega tomota taudi nigeya paꞌalidi sikabokaboedi, ta silisilisi iledi.

Ta ꞌomi niꞌatu tomota maiboꞌadi simwalatonimi ꞌaene tetela boboꞌana ꞌana toematamatanao, ꞌenega manumi yagwausowala sinabwana. Ta wate nuwanuwagu be bubuna boboꞌadi maiboꞌadi wada mwalatoi ꞌaiꞌailidi, ta bubuna toꞌumalidi waguitoyasedi.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, Yaubada tauna nuwasiwalowa ꞌalena, be sawesawenaya Seitani ꞌida ꞌausepale maniniye ꞌemiyega. ꞌEnega ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso ꞌina oboboma ꞌemiya ꞌida miyami.
Gete Timoti maꞌiyagu ꞌima oboboma ꞌiweewa, Timoti tauna maꞌiyagu ꞌapaipaisewa, ta wate ꞌaidi gosemao me Yudia ꞌediyega, taudi Lukio be Yesoni be Sosipateli.
ꞌAboꞌagu Telitiyasi leta gete yaꞌetoladina Paulo manuna, ꞌigu oboboma ꞌemiya ꞌida ꞌInapwana ꞌana esanega.

Ta wate tai nina ꞌina anuwaya ꞌamiyami, ꞌana esana Geyo, ꞌina oboboma ꞌemiya, anuwa getei toekalesiyao ꞌidi ꞌebe deliegogona. Ta wate Elasito, tauna ꞌasa gete sinabwana ꞌana mani ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌita, be tasidai Kwatasi, site luwa nidi ꞌidi oboboma ꞌemiya.
ꞌEnega gete tuga Yaubada tada tupuna, manuna tauna sawesawenaya be ꞌigiepaꞌalimi, ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌigu loguguya ꞌenega, nate Yesu Keliso tetelina ꞌenega. Tetela gete gimi tutaya kwaikwaiyina,

ta esi gete tuga niꞌatu ꞌigieapwesena ꞌedaya palopitao ꞌidi ꞌetoladiyao ꞌediyega, ta wate Yaubada miyamiya atayana ꞌiloina be ꞌaene sena maiboꞌana tomotediyao tetela gete sida mwalatoni, be ꞌenega sida emisa be sida muliye.
Yaubada tauna tebweuna Tosinasinapu ꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌenega Yesu Keliso ꞌana esanega tada tupuna, tuta maiboꞌana ꞌediya. Eimeni. ꞌAboꞌagu Paulo.
